messages.content: For my account user_123, please hold the best available recommendation for 1 Sony WH-1000XM5 in electronics, then use that recommended choice to create the cart item and place the order with the best discount using my credit_card. Use coupon code SAVE15, and note the original product_id is p_sony_xm5_blk. After that, generate an invoice for that item and send it to user@example.com via stripe, then email me an order and invoice summary as well. Also, check technology news, and schedule a medium-priority reminder called “Post-Purchase Follow-up” for user@example.com on 2026-01-16 from 10:00 to 10:30 with technology as the description. Please include the participants user@example.com and tags shopping and invoice, and finally remove the original black XM5 item from my cart.
